query: SELECT f.position AS "position!: i64", f.epoch AS "epoch!: i64", f.record_id AS "record_id!: String", f.router_time AS "time?: String", f.time_basis AS "time_basis!: String", p.thread_id AS "thread_id!: String", json_quote(json_extract(f.content, '$.record.record.placement')) AS "placement!: String", json_quote(json_extract(f.content, '$.record.record.actor')) AS "actor!: String" FROM project_feed f INDEXED BY feed_by_kind_position LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = f.record_id WHERE f.record_kind = 'post' AND f.position > ? AND f.position <= ? AND (? IS NULL OR p.thread_id = ? OR p.post_id IS NULL) ORDER BY f.position LIMIT ?
